item.title: Ogun Set to Join Oil-Producing States As NNPC Prepares Commercial Drilling At Eba
item.description: NNPC prepares for commercial oil production at Eba, Ogun Governor Abiodun hails milestone, anticipating jobs, growth, and federal investment.

item.title: BUA Group’s Rabiu Urges Africa To Shift From Raw Material Extraction To Industrial Value Addition
item.description: Abdul Samad Rabiu calls for industrialisation, urging Africa to process resources locally and capture greater economic value.

item.title: CBN Reopens Official FX Window To BDCs As Naira Rallies to 14-Month High At N1,348/$
item.description: Naira strengthens to 14-month high as CBN restores BDC access and boosts foreign exchange market liquidity.

item.title: Bank of Industry Channeled N636bn To 7,000 Businesses In 2025
item.description: BoI recorded historic N636bn disbursement in 2025, supporting 7,000 businesses and generating 1.6 million jobs.

item.title: Christian Group Replies Shari’a Council, Says Call For Election Boycott Will Worsen Religious Tensions
item.description: Christian group says calls to boycott elections over Amupitan’s appointment risk deepening sectarian tensions and undermining democracy.

item.title: Reps Warn Underfunding Auditor-General Could Worsen Corruption In Nigeria
item.description: House cautions that inadequate funding for Auditor-General risks weakening oversight, undermining transparency, and deepening corruption.

item.title: Germany Says Buhari’s $2.3bn Siemens Power Deal Dormant Until Tinubu Revived It
item.description: Germany confirms $2.3bn Siemens power deal stalled under Buhari but was revived under Tinubu to boost Nigeria’s energy sector.

item.title: Amaechi: ADC Northern Presidential Candidate Could Face Resistance In South Ahead Of 2027 Elections
item.description: Amaechi warns ADC may struggle to sell a northern presidential candidate in the South, urging careful consideration of zoning dynamics.

item.title: NAFDAC Denies Government Ordered Reversal Of Sachet, 200ml Alcohol Ban
item.description: NAFDAC refutes social media claims, confirming no directive to lift ban on sachet and 200ml alcoholic products.

item.title: Bayelsa Strengthens Angola Ties, Moves To Activate MoU With Namibe Province
item.description: Bayelsa aims to implement MoU with Angola’s Namibe Province, focusing on fisheries, aquaculture, and economic collaboration.
